name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 15 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 1.89 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
